children: NGI+ has been tokenized by AssetoFinance and is linked to the net asset value performance of Partners Group Next Generation Infrastructure strategy fund. The fund matures on December 10, 2026. According to Odaily, Partners Group manages about $186 billion in assets, the related fund is larger than $1 billion, and it has delivered a net return of 48.8% over the past 2.5 years with volatility below 2.5%. Pendle co-founder TN Lee said it was one of Pendle’s most exciting recent listings.

title: NGI+ Tokenized by AssetoFinance Tracks Partners Group Infrastructure Fund NAV
